stem.text: Two wires have the same length and the same resistance. Wire X is made of a metal of resistivity $1.7 \times 10^{-8}\,\Omega\,\text{m}$ and wire Y is made of a metal of resistivity $5.6 \times 10^{-8}\,\Omega\,\text{m}$.
The diameter of wire X is $0.315\,\text{mm}$.
What is the diameter of wire Y?
